QUICK GUIDE

From backtest to evidence.

  1. Save a completed report

    Run momentum and portfolio backtests on Definedge. Choose Save backtest after the report finishes.

  2. Inspect the full picture

    Open a run for statistics, numbered settings, original charts, trades and your notes. Review capture warnings.

  3. Compare like with like

    Use the same period and universe. Select at least two runs to compare results and changed settings.

  4. Keep an independent backup

    Back up all saves a JSON file. Import runs combines backups; matching IDs stay unchanged.

The browser viewer has its own local library. It does not connect to extension storage. Demo mode uses temporary fictional data.
